mechanics.title: Backups
mechanics.description: On death, inventory and gear are written to a file in the world folder (data/deathbackup), in a folder per player name. A reminder message is sent to players with command access (configurable).

commands_and_keybinds: /deathbackup list - list recent deaths with indices (0 is the latest)
getting_started: If you die and have operator access, run /deathbackup load 0. Otherwise ask a server operator.
editor_notes: Loading requires cheat-access (operator), so regular players need an admin.
name: Death Backup
summary: Saves a copy of each player's inventory and gear just before they die. Players with cheat/operator access can restore it with a command.
